name: Hasekura Makoto
source:
Makoto Shikura is a second-year student at the school.
He and Miai became siblings when their father remarried and came to live together.
He is generally good-natured and calm.
However, he was traumatized by his parents' divorce, and although his interactions with Miai have improved, he is still a little uncomfortable with women.
He respects Miai as an older sister for her patience with him, but at the same time, he is also becoming conscious of her as a woman.
